title: New in Symfony 8.2: Testing Improvements
content:
<html><head></head><body>In application tests you rarely make just one request: you submit a form, follow
the redirect, click a link, etc. Until now, a lot of what those requests
did (the emails they sent, the messages they queued, the services you replaced)
was gone by the time…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
